projects.name: Beacon
projects.text: Constructs a beacon that provides bonuses to clusters of planets

projects.name: Resource Details
projects.text: Adds a detail panel with resource stats. Accessed from resource panel

projects.name: Bottleneck Optimizations
projects.cost: 5 Titanium Bar, 25 Platinum Bar, 50 Steel Bar
projects.text: Adds red/green lights to planet panel; red on shipping/cargo means planet counts as backlogging

projects.name: Cargo Logistics
projects.text: Ability to prioritize which ore to pick up first, even if it isn't the most valuable

projects.name: Ore Targeting
projects.text: Prioritized ore on each planet receives +15% yield bonus

projects.name: Advanced Ore Targeting
projects.text: Prioritized ore on each planet receives +30% yield bonus
projects.note: Does not stack with Ore Targeting - net planet output is 130% instead of 115%

projects.name: Alchemy
projects.text: Convert an ore on a planet to an ore worth 1 level higher
projects.note: Upon researching, you immediately pick a planet to upgrade.

projects.name: Advanced Alchemy
projects.cost: 50k Silver Ore, 25k Titanium Ore, 6 Basic Computer
projects.text: Convert an ore on a planet to an ore worth 2 levels higher

projects.name: Superior Alchemy
projects.cost: 400 Palladium Bar, 200 Osmium Bar, 5 Advanced Computer
projects.text: Convert an ore on a planet to an ore worth 3 levels higher

projects.name: Asteroid Refined Drilling
projects.text: 10% chance of an asteroid containing 20x normal value worth of alloy
projects.note: Pink asteroids give smelted alloys, not raw ore.

projects.name: Asteroid Harvester
projects.text: All asteroids value x1.3

projects.name: Advanced Asteroid Harvester
projects.text: All asteroids value x1.3 (multiplicative with Asteroid Harvester)

projects.name: Superior Asteroid Harvester
projects.cost: 10 Nuclear Reactor, 300 Scrith Alloy, 600 Inerton Alloy
projects.text: All asteroids value x1.3 (multiplicative with Advanced Asteroid Harvester)

projects.name: Debris Scanner
projects.text: Allows discovery of debris fields that provide valuable items
projects.note: Debris gives crafted items, not raw ore/alloys.

projects.name: Debris Harvester
projects.text: All debris value x1.3

projects.name: Advanced Debris Harvester
projects.text: All debris value x1.3 (multiplicative with Debris Harvester)

projects.name: Superior Debris Harvester
projects.text: All debris value x1.3 (multiplicative with previous upgrades)

projects.name: Asteroid Auto Miner
projects.text: Automatically mine asteroids, even while idle
projects.note: Also will auto-mine while you are active

projects.name: Asteroid Scanner
projects.text: Frequency of asteroids increased by 30%

projects.name: Advanced Asteroid Scanner
projects.text: Frequency of asteroids increased by 30% (60% total timer reduction  to spawn)

projects.name: Market Insight
projects.text: Ability for forecast upcoming market changes

projects.name: Inside Trader
projects.text: +15% chance of positive market fluctuations on future changes

projects.name: Market Manipulation
projects.text: Chance of x4 positive market

projects.name: Advanced Market Manipulation
projects.text: Chance of x5 positive market

projects.name: Market Accelerator
projects.text: Ability to replace the current market with the following one, once every 8 hours

projects.name: Advanced Market Accelerator
projects.text: Ability to replace the current market with the following one a second time every 8 hours

projects.name: Rover Advanced Logistics
projects.text: Unlocks an additional mission choice for new scans

projects.name: Rover Scanning Module
projects.text: +5% chance of rovers finding all rewards

projects.name: Rover Resupply
projects.cost: 6 Platinum Bar, 1 Laser Torch, 1 Solar Panel
projects.text: Planets being scanned by a rover receive x2.5 bonus to mining speed, ship speed, and cargo

projects.name: Advanced Rover Resupply
projects.cost: 10 Advanced Battery, 6 Plasma Torch, 25 Rhodium Bar
projects.text: Planets being scanned by a rover receive x5 bonus instead of x2.5

projects.name: Advanced Specialist University
projects.text: All manager secondary benefits x1.05

projects.name: Colonization

projects.note: Bonuses are Mining, Speed, and Cargo Multipliers

projects.text: Increases max colonization tasks available from 3 to 4

projects.name: Colonization Advanced Scouting

projects.name: Colonization Superior Scouting
projects.text: Increases max colonization tasks available from 5 to 6

projects.name: Colonization Efficiency
projects.text: Colonization costs 20% less resources

projects.name: Colony Renegotiation
projects.text: Allows you to renegotiate colonization requests of planets

projects.name: Colonization Advanced Efficiency
projects.text: Colonization costs 20% less resources

projects.name: Colonization Superior Efficiency
projects.text: Colonization costs 20% less resources

projects.name: Terraforming
projects.text: Increases one purchased planet's colonization level by 2 instantly

projects.name: Advanced Terraforming
projects.text: Increases one purchased planet's colonization level by 3 instantly

projects.name: Colony Tax Incentives
projects.text: Planet upgrades reduced by 5% per colony level (mine, speed, cargo)

projects.name: Colony Advanced Tax Incentives

projects.name: Colony Superior Tax Incentives

projects.name: Rover
projects.text: Ability to scan planets for valuable items
projects.note: Finds dark matter, boosts, and occasionally resource stars and managers.

credits_past_table: each decade 10x more: the next triangular number x10 (the wiki's words)

formulas: Upgraded Base Cargo (at level) = 5 + 2 * (level - 1) + 0.1 * (level - 1)2 [rounded (using rounding half to even) after application of bonus modifiers]
Base Upgrade Price (at level, in order to reach level + 1) = (Planet's Unlock Price/20) * 1.3level - 1 [rounded only for display, not for actual spending]
